question: What happens to practitioners who rely only on ritual conduct without knowing the truth?
premises: Some practitioners do not know the truth.
They are fixed only in ritual conduct.
When their mind wavers, their knowledge is damaged.
inference: For those grounded only in conduct, mental instability leads to a loss of knowledge.
plain_english: Those who do not know the truth and are devoted only to ritual conduct suffer a loss of knowledge when their minds begin to waver.
